001package com.streamconverter.command.impl.xml;
002
003import com.streamconverter.UncheckedStreamException;
004import com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand;
005import com.streamconverter.command.rule.IRule;
006import com.streamconverter.path.TreePath;
007import com.streamconverter.security.SecureXmlConfiguration;
008import java.io.IOException;
009import java.io.InputStream;
010import java.io.OutputStream;
011import java.util.ArrayList;
012import java.util.List;
013import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventFactory;
014import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventReader;
015import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventWriter;
016import javax.xml.stream.XMLInputFactory;
017import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
018import javax.xml.stream.events.XMLEvent;
019import org.slf4j.Logger;
020import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
021
022/**
023 * XML Walker for applying transformations to XML data.
024 *
025 * <p>This command navigates through XML structures and applies transformations using rules while
026 * preserving the overall XML structure. It identifies specific elements using TreePath
027 * slash-delimited path expressions (e.g., {@code product/name}) and applies {@link IRule}
028 * transformations to the text content of matching nodes.
029 *
030 * <p>The full XML event stream — including the XML declaration, all elements, attributes, and text
031 * nodes — is written to the output. Only character data at nodes whose path exactly matches the
032 * configured {@link TreePath} is transformed by the rule; all other events are passed through with
033 * their XML information set (infoset) preserved.
034 *
035 * <p>Note on text handling: the underlying StAX reader is configured with {@code
036 * XMLInputFactory.IS_COALESCING}, so adjacent text fragments and CDATA sections are coalesced into
037 * a single character event before rules are applied. This guarantees that a rule sees the whole
038 * text content of a node even when the parser would otherwise split it (e.g. at CDATA boundaries).
039 * As a consequence, CDATA sections are written to the output as escaped character data — an
040 * infoset-equivalent representation — rather than being preserved verbatim.
041 */
042public class XmlWalker implements IStreamCommand {
043  private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(XmlWalker.class);
044
045  private final TreePath treePath;
046  private final IRule rule;
047
048  /**
049   * Constructor for XML navigation with TreePath selector and transformation rule.
050   *
051   * @param treePath the TreePath to select elements
052   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
053   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if treePath or rule is null
054   */
055  XmlWalker(TreePath treePath, IRule rule) {
056    if (treePath == null) {
057      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null");
058    }
059    if (rule == null) {
060      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
061    }
062    this.treePath = treePath;
063    this.rule = rule;
064  }
065
066  /**
067   * Factory method for creating an XML navigation command with TreePath and rule.
068   *
069   * @param treePath the TreePath to select elements
070   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
071   * @return an XmlWalker that transforms the specified TreePath elements with the given rule
072   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if treePath or rule is null
073   */
074  public static XmlWalker create(TreePath treePath, IRule rule) {
075    if (treePath == null) {
076      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null");
077    }
078    if (rule == null) {
079      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
080    }
081    return new XmlWalker(treePath, rule);
082  }
083
084  @Override
085  public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
086    XMLEventReader eventReader = null;
087    XMLEventWriter eventWriter = null;
088    IOException primaryException = null;
089
090    try {
091      eventReader = createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
092      eventWriter = createXMLEventWriter(outputStream);
093      navigateXmlWithRule(eventReader, eventWriter, treePath);
094      eventWriter.flush();
095    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
096      primaryException = buildXmlException(e);
097    } catch (IOException e) {
098      // ルール層から unwrap された I/O 障害（分類 B）。型を変えず、close 失敗の suppressed 連結
099      // を XMLStreamException 経路と同様に行うため primaryException に乗せる
100      primaryException = e;
101    } finally {
102      primaryException = XmlStreamResources.closeAll(eventReader, eventWriter, primaryException);
103    }
104
105    if (primaryException != null) {
106      throw primaryException;
107    }
108  }
109
110  private void navigateXmlWithRule(
111      XMLEventReader eventReader, XMLEventWriter eventWriter, TreePath treePath)
112      throws XMLStreamException, IOException {
113    XMLEventFactory eventFactory = XMLEventFactory.newInstance();
114    List<String> currentPath = new ArrayList<>();
115
116    while (eventReader.hasNext()) {
117      XMLEvent event = eventReader.nextEvent();
118
119      if (event.isStartElement()) {
120        currentPath.add(event.asStartElement().getName().getLocalPart());
121      } else if (event.isEndElement()) {
122        if (currentPath.isEmpty()) {
123          logger.warn(
124              "Unexpected end element '{}' with empty path stack — possible malformed XML",
125              event.asEndElement().getName().getLocalPart());
126        } else {
127          currentPath.remove(currentPath.size() - 1);
128        }
129      } else if (event.isCharacters() && treePath.matches(currentPath)) {
130        String transformed = applyRule(event.asCharacters().getData(), currentPath);
131        // Write every event unconditionally; character events at the target path are replaced
132        // above.
133        event = eventFactory.createCharacters(transformed);
134      }
135
136      eventWriter.add(event);
137    }
138  }
139
140  @SuppressWarnings({"PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException", "PMD.PreserveStackTrace"})
141  // IRule.apply() declares no checked exceptions. Rule-layer I/O failures arrive wrapped in the
142  // UncheckedStreamException carrier and are unwrapped at this command boundary (#741); the cause
143  // already records the rule-site stack trace, so discarding the carrier loses no diagnostics.
144  // Any other RuntimeException is wrapped as XMLStreamException so the caller's error-handling
145  // path is not bypassed.
146  private String applyRule(String data, List<String> currentPath)
147      throws XMLStreamException, IOException {
148    try {
149      return rule.apply(data);
150    } catch (UncheckedStreamException carrier) {
151      throw carrier.getCause();
152    } catch (RuntimeException ruleEx) {
153      throw new XMLStreamException("Rule application failed at path " + currentPath, ruleEx);
154    }
155  }
156
157  private XMLEventReader createXMLEventReader(InputStream inputStream) throws XMLStreamException {
158    XMLInputFactory inputFactory = SecureXmlConfiguration.createSecureXMLInputFactory();
159    // テキスト断片化防止のため coalescing を有効化する。CDATA 境界やパーサ内部バッファで
160    // 分割された連続テキストを 1 つの Characters イベントに結合し、ルールがテキスト
161    // コンテンツ全体に適用されることを保証する (#762)。XmlWalker ローカルの設定であり、
162    // SecureXmlConfiguration を共有する他コマンドには影響しない。
163    inputFactory.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.IS_COALESCING, true);
164    XMLEventReader reader = inputFactory.createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
165    if (!reader.hasNext()) {
166      try {
167        reader.close();
168      } catch (XMLStreamException closeEx) {
169        logger.warn("Failed to close empty XMLEventReader", closeEx);
170      }
171      throw new XMLStreamException("Empty XML input");
172    }
173    return reader;
174  }
175
176  /**
177   * 出力ストリームへの XMLEventWriter を作成する。
178   *
179   * <p>テスト時にオーバーライドしてファクトリをモック可能にするため protected スコープとしている。
180   *
181   * @param outputStream 書き込み先ストリーム
182   * @return 設定済み XMLEventWriter
183   * @throws XMLStreamException ライターの生成に失敗した場合
184   */
185  protected XMLEventWriter createXMLEventWriter(OutputStream outputStream)
186      throws XMLStreamException {
187    return SecureXmlConfiguration.createSecureXMLOutputFactory().createXMLEventWriter(outputStream);
188  }
189
190  private IOException buildXmlException(XMLStreamException e) {
191    String location = "";
192    if (e.getLocation() != null) {
193      int line = e.getLocation().getLineNumber();
194      int column = e.getLocation().getColumnNumber();
195      if (line > 0 && column > 0) {
196        location = String.format(" at line %d, column %d", line, column);
197      }
198    }
199    logger.error("XML processing failed{}", location, e);
200    return new IOException("XML processing failed" + location, e);
201  }
202}
